results.title: About AtmaGo | AtmaGo
results.content:
AtmaGo is managed by Sakawarga, a nonprofit Indonesian entity who is the Indonesia sister organization to Atma Connect which is a nonprofit organization headquartered in California. We believe in building on the power of people to create stronger and more resilient communities. Learn more about Atma Connect on our website atmaconnect.org and Sakawarga on sakawarga.org. [...] [](

# About AtmaGo

We envision a world where neighbors help neighbors prepare for disasters, improve access to basic needs, and overcome chronic challenges.

AtmaGo is a free website and Android app that you can use to report problems, share solutions, find jobs, and post news about your community. AtmaGo is built on the idea that when neighbors help neighbors we can make our community better from the ground up. Follow us on Facebook to learn more.
